items.one_liner: APT29 is actively using n-day exploits to target mobile users via compromised websites, emphasizing the critical need for OS updates.
items.summary: The Russian state-sponsored threat actor APT29 (Midnight Blizzard) is conducting a watering hole campaign targeting users of unpatched mobile devices.
